name: contract-base
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

V_VDD (vdd 0) vsource dc=1.0
V_VSS (vss 0) vsource dc=0.1
V_IN (in vss) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 240n 0.9]
V_CLK (clk vss) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=20n delay=1n rise=200p fall=200p width=10n
XDUT (vdd vss in clk out) sample_hold

tran tran stop=240n maxstep=2p strobeperiod=2p
save vdd vss in clk out

name: contract-stretched-input
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

V_VDD (vdd 0) vsource dc=1.0
V_VSS (vss 0) vsource dc=0.1

name: irregular-clock-stop-and-large-jumps
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0
ahdl_include "dut.va"
VDD (vdd 0) vsource dc=1.0
VSS (vss 0) vsource dc=.1
VIN (in vss) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 .1 5n .1 10n .8 20n .8 25n .2 40n .7 50n .7]
VCLK (clk vss) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 4n 0 4.12n .9 6n .9 6.12n 0 14n 0 14.12n .9 16n .9 16.12n 0 27n 0 27.12n .9 28n .9 28.12n 0 50n 0]
X (vdd vss in clk out) sample_hold
tran tran stop=50n maxstep=2p strobeperiod=2p
save vdd vss in clk out
